title: Complete rulebook/GM palette and dated dispatch qualifications
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete rulebook/GM palette, dated engine observations and dispatch with later settings-direction refinement
reviews.disposition:
Full-content review covers V1–V6, RB1–RB12/R1–R10, both meanings of GM, GM1–GM7/GMA1–GMA5, MV1–MV20, NR1–NR37/OS1–OS5, EX1–EX9, EP1–EP10/EC1–EC9/EA1–EA18, HD1–HD9/NB1–NB10/MC5, every disposition and the final OD16/MD1–MD5 fold. The original proposals, quoted requests, dated source inspection and dispatch are retained.

**Authority and sequencing.** Resolution, progression and law profiles remain useful independent design axes; a cosmology need not share one engine profile, and a traveler can retain actual capabilities across different local rules. These are a palette, not a requirement to install three records everywhere. The opening D&D-first consumer, EP build order, mandatory two-profile exercise and six-lane dispatch describe October14 planning. Current focus and selected consumers follow [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [accepted direction](USER_VISION.md) and [architecture rules](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md). Existing player/NPC mechanisms, native owners and the first useful shared seam come first; a second world validates reuse when relevant. No new workers, D&D wave, generic resolver, DSL, universal ledger or content import is dispatched by this reconciliation.

**Bounded implementation observations.** EX observations and the 474-file count are dated evidence. The absence of a shared resolver was explicitly inferred from a name search, not a complete negative audit. Do not infer today's missing or completed systems from those rows, module names, the dispatch authorization or a proposed acceptance check. Extend the actual selected owners after inspection. MV4/EA1's small resolver-family set and the claim that every later book costs at most one variant are hypotheses, not a completeness guarantee; an actual mechanism may need a different local implementation. A shared world profile need not absorb an actor's personal System, institution policy, zone law or imported capability into one override hierarchy.

**Mechanisms and knowledge.** A scale class helps describe contact but is not a universal rank wall, permission list or forced balance conversion. R8's imported strength may work through its actual mechanisms without compensatory punishment; the same applies to NPC travelers and personal Systems. GM7 motivates authored moves and optional intent interpretation, not a requirement for a language model or proof that deterministic combination rules cannot support useful intent. GMA3's explicit policy and later OD16 qualify earlier life-start/freeze wording: comfort controls remain freely available, prospective policies explain pending commitments, and actual in-world means may change laws or history. A revision lock protects a committed instance against accidental content edits; it does not prohibit supported rule-changing play or an explicit migration.

Keep actual resolution probabilities separate from the player's means of knowing them. EA2/EA17 can support exact internal odds and replay without granting every observer those odds or hidden draw addresses. MV10's numberless-world example does not revoke the own-status direction in [the rules index](RULES_INDEX.md); opponent knowledge, discovered local laws and in-world appraisal still depend on their means. EA18 reasons use current [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), including the distinction between a useful known obstruction and an ownerless developer refusal. A developer GM screen does not silently unseal truth to ordinary play.

**Sources and verification.** V1–V6 are this document's historical license/source observations, while NR/HD licensing and availability were expressly unverified leads. Structured data, an SRD label, a repository or a validator does not establish compatible edition, permission for each included item, correct mechanical interpretation or runnable behavior. Preserve edition, source, revision and attribution at the actual import; the share-alike file-separation suggestion remains an inference, not a settled reuse conclusion. MC5-5's seed sweep can check an odds implementation but cannot alone prove exact probabilities. Historical 1366×768 and human acceptance language do not replace the current desktop target and verification floor. This review read documentation only: no external license verification, acquisitions, current code audit, test, build, browser or persistence proof.

Useful work stays with this palette, [generation foundations](GENERATION_FOUNDATION_RULES_2026-10-14.md), [multiverse structures](worlds/MULTIVERSE_STRUCTURES.md) and each selected world owner. Reopen a concrete row when an authorized consumer needs that mechanism or fresh source/behavior evidence, retaining the original codes and history.
reviews.evidence: Read all 540 pre-fold lines in three contiguous ranges, 1–180,181–360,361–540. Dated facts and proposals retained as such; no external verification or current runtime proof.
reviews.reopen: Reopen selected rulebook/profile or GM mechanism only for an authorized actual consumer, source/edition/license check or current implementation verification.
